evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to support pruning
rationale: Allows running -txindex concurrently with block pruning, resolving multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). Pruned nodes gain the ability to maintain transaction lookups without storing full historical block data on disk.
